The kit features a top handle and internal elastic loops holding various tools, including screwdrivers with yellow handles, pliers, and a small level. To the left of the main kit, several loose tools are scattered, including a green-handled utility knife, a tape measure, and other small implements. A folded black pouch or flap lies in the foreground.
